title: HR Research & Strategy Associate (AI TOOLS KNOWLEDGE MUST)
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Careerbloc is a fast\-evolving HR tech and workforce strategy consultancy operating at the intersection of human capital, data\-driven insights, and generative AI. We empower organizations across India to future\-proof their talent ecosystems by embedding intelligent automation, predictive workforce analytics, and AI\-augmented decision\-making into core HR functions. As we scale our research and strategy vertical, we’re seeking a sharp, tech\-savvy HR Research \& Strategy Associate who thrives on translating AI tools into actionable people strategies.
 **Role \& Responsibilities**
* Conduct workforce trend research using AI\-powered tools (e.g., LinkedIn Talent Insights, Eightfold, Gloat, Beamery) to identify emerging talent gaps, mobility patterns, and skill adjacencies.
* Design and deploy AI\-augmented survey instruments and sentiment analysis models to measure employee experience, DEI sentiment, and culture health.
* Collaborate with leadership to translate AI\-driven insights into scalable HR strategies — including workforce planning, competency modeling, and retention playbooks.
* Partner with data science teams to preprocess and validate HR datasets for predictive modeling (e.g., attrition risk, promotion potential).
* Document and evangelize use cases of AI HR tools across internal and client\-facing teams — creating toolkits, playbooks, and training modules.
* Stay ahead of the curve on HR Tech innovation — continuously evaluating new AI vendors, benchmarking ROI, and recommending pilot integrations.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Must\-Have**
* Experience with AI HR platforms (e.g., Eightfold, Phenom, Lattice, Visier, HireVue)
* Proficiency in data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
* Familiarity with HR analytics frameworks (e.g., People Analytics, Workforce Analytics)
* Strong understanding of HR tech stack (ATS, HRIS, LMS, HRMS)
* Ability to interpret machine learning model outputs for HR decision\-making
* Experience with NLP tools for employee feedback analysis (e.g., Qualtrics XM, Medallia, Gensuite)


**Preferred**
* Exposure to Python or R for HR data analysis (Pandas, Scikit\-learn)
* Background in organizational psychology or behavioral economics
* Experience with generative AI tools in HR context (e.g., ChatGPT for job description generation, Claude for policy drafting)


**Benefits \& Culture Highlights**
* Work directly with enterprise clients and Fortune 500 HR teams — shaping the future of work in India.
* Access to cutting\-edge AI HR tool stack — get certified and build expertise on platforms you’ll use daily.
* Remote\-first culture with on\-site collaboration days — hybrid flexibility with impact\-driven autonomy.

title: GM/AVP- Corporate HR
description:
Role Summary
 
 ICCS is looking for a GM / AVP – Corporate HR to own the corporate and leadership layer of the people agenda — senior and leadership hiring, policy design and governance, compensation benchmarking, performance management, and the digitisation of employee journeys on HRMS. This is the counterpart to the frontline TA and ER charters: where those roles run volume hiring and floor\-level retention, this role owns the corporate and leadership people function end to end, including succession and internal mobility for that population.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Senior \& Leadership Hiring** 




 •    Own senior leadership and corporate function hiring end to end, including search\-partner management and commercial oversight.
 



 •    Directly close leadership hires at GM, AVP and VP level, partnering with business heads on role definition and offer construct.
 



**2\. Policy \& Compliance Framework** 




 •    Build and maintain the corporate policy framework and ensure consistent application across all ICCS sites.
 



 •    Own policy design and rollout — not administration alone — including change management for new or revised policies.
 



**3\. Compensation \& Benchmarking** 




 •    Own compensation benchmarking and banding for corporate and leadership roles, using recognised market survey data.
 



 •    Advise business and HR leadership on pay positioning, internal equity and banding for new leadership requisitions.
 



**4\. Performance Management** 




 •    Design and run the performance management cycle for corporate and leadership populations, end to end.
 



 •    Drive full\-coverage, on\-time completion of the cycle and quality of ratings distribution.
 



**5\. HRMS \& Digitisation** 




 •    Digitise employee journeys on HRMS — onboarding, confirmation, transfers, performance, exit — with a measurable reduction in manual effort.
 



 •    Own HRMS rollout as business owner (not as an IT project manager), including adoption across sites.
 



**6\. Retention \& Succession** 




 •    Own corporate retention, succession planning and internal mobility for the leadership and corporate population.
 



**7\. HR Analytics** 




 •    Build HR analytics and dashboards for the leadership team covering hiring, attrition, performance and HRMS adoption.
 



  




 Desired Candidate Profile
 
**Experience \& Background** 




 •    15\+ years in Corporate HR / HR Business Partnering, with direct ownership of leadership hiring, policy design and HRMS rollout.
 



 •    Mandatory: experience in a services / BPO organisation of comparable scale (5,000\+ employees, multi\-site delivery footprint).
 



 •    Has directly closed leadership hires at GM, AVP and VP level.
 



 •    Has owned policy design and rollout, not just administration.
 



 •    Has run at least one HRMS implementation or a significant module rollout, as business owner rather than as an IT project manager.
 



 •    Compensation benchmarking experience using recognised survey data (e.g. Mercer, Aon, industry compensation surveys).
 



**Preferred** 




 •    Exposure to organisations that have been through a fundraise, audit\-readiness or listing process.
 



 •    Experience designing ESOP or long\-term incentive structures.
 



**Not a Fit** 




 •    Pure recruiters with no policy, performance or HRMS ownership.
 



 •    Candidates who have only administered HRMS rather than led a rollout.
 



**Education** 




 •    Postgraduate / MBA in Human Resources preferred.
 



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    Senior stakeholder management, including with CXOs and the CEO's office.
 



 •    Policy design, governance and change management across a multi\-site organisation.
 



 •    Compensation benchmarking and banding for leadership roles.
 



 •    HRMS / HR\-tech digital transformation ownership.
 



 •    Performance management cycle design and execution.
 



 •    HR analytics and dashboard\-building for leadership reporting.

title: Strategic Human Resources Business Partner
description:
We are seeking an experienced
 **Senior HR Business Partner (HRBP)** 
 to partner with our critical global business units. This is a high\-impact, strategic role that works closely with Business Unit Heads and senior global leaders to drive people strategy, organizational effectiveness, and long\-term capability building.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is a seasoned HR professional with experience partnering with global stakeholders (preferably across the UK, US, or other international markets). You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing business outcomes through strategic HR initiatives, leadership development, and organizational transformation. This role requires someone who operates as a true business partner—not just an HR representative.
 



  





**\*\*Must have experience working with a US staffing company\*\*** 




**Shift:** 
 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office (5 days a week)
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Strategic Business Partnership
 


* Act as a trusted advisor to Business Unit Heads and senior leadership, influencing key decisions related to people strategy, organizational structure, and leadership capability.
* Partner with global and regional leaders across the UK, US, and other international markets on workforce planning, leadership development, and organizational design.
* Collaborate with global business leaders to drive consistency in people processes and HR best practices across regions.
* Align HR initiatives with business objectives to support organizational growth and transformation.



  





 Talent Management
 


* Partner with business leaders to conduct talent reviews, succession planning, and leadership pipeline development for critical roles.
* Lead performance management, talent assessments, succession planning, and annual compensation planning for assigned business units.
* Provide strategic guidance on promotions, incentives, and compensation decisions in collaboration with Finance and HR Centers of Excellence (CoEs).
* Identify and develop high\-potential talent while strengthening leadership capability across the organization.



  





 Organizational Effectiveness \& Change Management
 


* Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence (Recruitment, Learning \& Development, Compensation \& Benefits, and DEI) to successfully implement enterprise HR programs.
* Anticipate organizational and people\-related risks, proactively recommending solutions and corrective actions in partnership with business leaders.
* Support organizational change initiatives, restructuring, and workforce transformation programs.
* Drive a high\-performance culture through effective change management and leadership coaching.



  





 Employee Experience \& Engagement
 


* Champion an exceptional employee experience across geographically distributed and multicultural teams.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex employee relations matters, ensuring fairness, consistency, and compliance with company policies.
* Partner with business leaders to improve employee engagement, strengthen organizational culture, and foster trust and transparency.
* Analyze engagement trends and recommend actionable initiatives to enhance employee satisfaction and retention.



  





 Key Requirements
 


* 10–12 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 5 years in an HR Business Partner role.
* Experience partnering with senior global stakeholders in a matrixed or multi\-region organization.
* Exposure to supporting business leaders across the UK, US, or other international markets is highly preferred.
* Strong ability to influence, coach, and build trusted relationships with senior leaders.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience in organizational design, workforce planning, talent management, and change management.
* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

title: GM/AVP- Employee Relations and Retention
description:
Role Summary
 
 ICCS is looking for a General Manager / AVP – Employee Relations \& Retention to own attrition as a business number across ICCS's approximately 5,000\-employee, 10\+ site PAN India footprint, and to run the compliance\-first ER case function that supports it. In a domestic BPO, attrition is the single largest controllable cost driver — this role exists to move that number, not merely to administer grievance and disciplinary process around it. It is for a seasoned ER / attrition leader who has run a high\-volume ER function inside a BPO / ITES / contact\-centre environment — grievance handling, disciplinary process and domestic enquiries, POSH compliance — and has personally owned and moved an attrition number at scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Attrition Ownership \& Retention Strategy** 




 •    Own the PAN India attrition target; publish and defend attrition performance to the CEO's office monthly.
 



 •    Design and run retention programmes targeted at the 0–90 day window, where most frontline attrition occurs.
 



 •    Build exit analytics — reason codes, tenure cohorts, site and process\-level patterns — and convert them into operational interventions, not just engagement activity.
 



 •    Partner with Operations leadership so retention actions land with team leaders, not only with HR.
 



**2\. PAN India ER Strategy \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER framework end\-to\-end for all ICCS centres (Noida, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai and any new sites), ensuring consistent grievance redressal, disciplinary process and investigation protocols.
 



 •    Own ER case TAT and SLA commitments against every open case, and personally intervene on high\-risk or aging matters.
 



 •    Build and standardise ER policies, SOPs and escalation matrices consistently across all sites and processes.
 



**3\. Grievance Handling \& Investigations** 




 •    Lead or oversee investigations into employee complaints — misconduct, harassment, policy violations — ensuring principles of natural justice are followed throughout.
 



 •    Conduct or supervise disciplinary hearings and domestic enquiries, working closely with site HR and Operations.
 



 •    Ensure fair, prompt and confidential handling of every case, with documentation that stands up to audit and legal scrutiny.
 



**4\. Statutory Compliance \& POSH** 




 •    Own POSH compliance PAN India — constitution and functioning of Internal Committees (IC) at every location, awareness sessions, and timely closure of complaints within statutory timelines.
 



 •    Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Contract Labour Act, and other state\-specific regulations across all centres.
 



 •    Liaise with legal counsel on ER matters that carry litigation or regulatory risk.
 



**5\. Employee Engagement \& Listening** 




 •    Run skip\-level connects, engagement surveys and floor\-level listening mechanisms, particularly at frontline/production level.
 



 •    Analyse exit interview and case data to identify ER\-linked attrition drivers and recommend systemic fixes to Operations and HR leadership.
 



**6\. Stakeholder \& Team Management** 




 •    Manage works/grievance committees as required under Standing Orders, and act as the primary liaison between employees, Operations leadership and HR on sensitive matters.
 



 •    Partner closely with Operations, Legal and Compliance teams on high\-risk or reputationally sensitive cases.
 



 •    Build, mentor and manage a PAN India ER team of 8–10 across locations — setting case\-quality, TAT and attrition\-outcome standards.
 



**7\. Reporting \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER and attrition dashboard and report monthly on attrition performance, case volumes, TAT, closure rates and POSH compliance status to the CEO's office and Head – HR.
 



 •    Maintain complete case documentation and ensure audit\-readiness across all centres at all times.
 



  




 Desired Candidate Profile
 
**Experience \& Background** 




 •    15\+ years in Employee Relations / Industrial Relations, with direct ownership of an attrition number — not case management alone.
 



 •    Has owned an attrition number across a workforce of 3,000 or more in a BPO or similar high\-churn environment, with a measurable, personally\-driven reduction backed by before\-and\-after figures.
 



 •    Mandatory: current or recent experience within the BPO / ITES / Contact Centre / Shared Services industry, with direct ER exposure in a high\-volume, frontline environment.
 



 •    Managed a PAN India, multi\-location ER team of 8 or more (minimum 3–4 locations), ideally including Noida/Delhi\-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Chennai.
 



 •    Hands\-on experience conducting domestic enquiries and POSH investigations, from complaint intake through to closure.
 



 •    Working knowledge of applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, POSH Act, Contract Labour Act and related state regulations, including contract labour compliance.
 



 •    Experience partnering with Legal and Operations leadership on high\-risk or litigation\-prone cases.
 



**Preferred** 




 •    Experience in a unionised or union\-attempt environment.
 



 •    Exposure to predictive attrition analytics.
 



**Not a Fit** 




 •    Generalist HRBPs who have supported attrition initiatives without owning the number.
 



 •    Corporate or white\-collar ER backgrounds with no frontline, high\-churn exposure.
 



 •    Candidates who describe retention purely as engagement activity — events, celebrations, rewards — with no analytical basis.
 



**Education** 




 •    Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
 



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    Ownership of an attrition number as a business metric, backed by data.
 



 •    Strong working knowledge of labour law and statutory compliance.
 



 •    Excellent investigation, case\-management and documentation skills.
 



 •    Stakeholder management across Operations, Legal and employees at all levels.
 



 •    High emotional intelligence, discretion and conflict\-resolution ability.
 



 •    Team building and people leadership across a distributed, PAN India team.
 



 •    Data orientation — comfortable building and defending an attrition / case\-management dashboard/MIS.
 



 •    Ability to operate calmly and objectively in a fast\-paced, high\-volume, sensitive\-case environment.

**About NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT)**
 NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT) is India’s leading Aerospace \& Defence innovation company developing next\-generation autonomous systems, AI\-driven aerial platforms, and advanced technologies for defence and dual\-use applications.
   

  

 Our teams work at the intersection of engineering, product development, and manufacturing, solving complex real\-world problems with speed, precision, and purpose. Our portfolio includes intelligent uncrewed systems such as Autonomous Swarming Drones, Collaborative Combat Aerial Vehicles (CCAV), Tethered Platforms, High\-Altitude Pseudo Satellites (HAPS), Loitering Munitions, and many more.
   

  

 With 500\+ engineers across R\&D and manufacturing, we collaborate with leading Indian and global Defence \& Aerospace organizations to build the future of autonomous systems.

 We’re looking for a hands\-on, strategic HR Business Partner to work closely with leaders across engineering, product, and manufacturing functions — the teams shaping India’s next generation of aerospace and technology systems.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high\-performance, high\-velocity environment, understands technology and manufacturing cultures, and can translate business goals into people strategies. * Conduct skip\-level connects, stay interviews, and feedback sessions to identify engagement drivers.

* Partner with HR Operations to ensure timely and accurate payroll inputs, employee records, and documentation.

* Work closely with Finance for payroll audits, budget validation, and manpower cost controls.

* Manage on\-ground administrative HR tasks — employee data updates, vendor HR coordination, and HR\-related communication for the BU/site.

* Master’s degree in Human Resources or Business Management (Engineering background preferred).
